tagline: Bitcoin mining leader focused on operational efficiency and cost optimization
hero_kpi_rationale: Mining operating margin is the primary profitability indicator in Bitcoin extraction, directly linked to competitiveness against BTC price volatility and energy costs. It is the key economic driver for ARBK.

kpis.name: Mining operating margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of profit generated on each Bitcoin mined after direct costs.
kpis.description: Margin declined versus Q2 2023 (46%) due to Bitcoin halving in April 2024, which cut block reward by half.
kpis.signal: Margin down post-halving, but remains positive.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated from sale of mined Bitcoin and energy credits.
kpis.description: Revenue primarily from sale of mined Bitcoin (188 BTC total in H1 2024), impacted by April 2024 halving.
kpis.signal: Revenue down linked to halving and market volatility.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Decline explained by lower production post-halving, despite controlled cost management.
kpis.signal: Adjusted EBITDA sharply down, reflecting margin pressure post-halving.

kpis.name: Bitcoin mined
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of Bitcoin extracted during the period.
kpis.description: Stable production despite halving, thanks to operational optimization and hashrate capacity improvements.
kpis.signal: 188 BTC mined in Q2 2024, approximately 2 BTC per day.

kpis.name: Direct cost per BTC mined
kpis.explanation: Average cost to mine one Bitcoin, excluding depreciation.
kpis.description: $38,989 per BTC mined in Q2 2024, reflecting maintained operational efficiency and optimized energy consumption management.
kpis.signal: Competitive cost despite halving pressure and energy volatility.

kpis.name: Cash balance
kpis.explanation: Amount of cash on hand at end of quarter.
kpis.description: $4.0M in cash at end of June 2024, supplemented by $8.3M raise in July 2024 strengthening liquidity position.
kpis.signal: Limited cash in June 2024, reinforced by subsequent fundraising.

kpis.name: Debt reduction
kpis.explanation: Amount of debt repaid since May 2023.
kpis.description: $35M in Galaxy debt repaid since May 2023, including $7.2M during Q2 2024, improving financial leverage.
kpis.signal: Significant Galaxy debt reduction secured since May 2023.

kpis.name: Hashrate capacity
kpis.explanation: Computing power dedicated to Bitcoin extraction, measured in exahashes per second.
kpis.description: Capacity distributed between Helios (~2.4 EH/s) and Baie-Comeau (~0.3 EH/s), representing strategic mining infrastructure.
kpis.signal: Operational capacity of 2.7 EH/s deployed across two main sites.

kpis.name: Mining operating margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of profit generated on each Bitcoin mined after direct costs.
kpis.description: Margin declined versus Q2 2023 (46%) due to Bitcoin halving in April 2024, which cut block reward by half.
kpis.signal: Margin down post-halving, but remains positive.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated from sale of mined Bitcoin and energy credits.
kpis.description: Revenue primarily from sale of mined Bitcoin (188 BTC total in H1 2024), impacted by April 2024 halving.
kpis.signal: Revenue down linked to halving and market volatility.

risks.title: Dependence on cryptocurrency asset market value
risks.score_rationale: Risk highlighted in risk summary and detailed extensively; very direct language ("substantially dependent"); trend stable but structurally critical; major weight for mining operator business model.

risks.title: Technological obsolescence and mining equipment supply chain
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly mentioned in summary; moderate but sector-specific language; uptrend (climate disruptions and equipment shortages); direct impact on operational competitiveness.

risks.title: Transition of networks to proof-of-stake (PoS)
risks.score_rationale: Risk specific to PoW model explicitly cited; alert language ("could make us less competitive"); uptrend (Ethereum migrated in 2022); existential threat to business model.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party mining pool operators
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in summary; clear language on dependence ("rely on"); stable trend; direct operational impact but mitigable through diversification.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks and digital asset theft
risks.score_rationale: Two distinct risks cited (third-party custodian and own cyberattacks); elevated alert language ("could result in loss"); uptrend (mounting threats); potentially catastrophic impact on assets.

risks.title: Regulatory uncertainty on cryptocurrency mining
risks.score_rationale: Major risk cited twice (summary and detailed section); strong uncertainty language ("cannot be certain"); uptrend (rapidly evolving regulations); potential impact on operational viability.

risks.title: Access to electricity at economically viable costs
risks.score_rationale: Risk specific to mining sector cited explicitly; moderate but direct language ("may not be able"); uptrend (rising energy costs); critical impact on operating margin.

risks.title: Intense competition with better-resourced players
risks.score_rationale: Risk cited in summary; direct language ("highly competitive"); stable but structural trend; impact on market share and margins.

ai_positioning.summary: Argo Blockchain mentions no AI strategy or investment. Its activity is entirely focused on Bitcoin extraction via specialized hardware and energy efficiency optimization.
evidence: No AI mention in Q2 2024 presentations or results.
Exclusive focus on energy efficiency and Bitcoin hashrate.
No documented AI or HPC compute partnerships or projects.
